services.desc: You and your pirate crew have fallen victim to a curse and transformed into fishmen! The only cure is locked deep within an island temple - but time is running out. Available Mon-Thurs 9:30 am-12:30 pm Private bookings only (outside regular hours) The entire experience from start to finish usually takes 1 to 1.5 hours. blurb: Guests participate in themed escape rooms and virtual reality escape games, solving puzzles and challenges to escape within a time limit. The VR games are multiplayer and use free-roaming technology. Private and public bookings are available, with options for corporate events and parties.
extraNote: Arrive at least 10 minutes early · No refunds or rescheduling for late arrival · Private bookings available Mon-Fri daytime · Public sessions available evenings and weekends · Pricing varies by room, day, and private or public booking
